# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security problem.

Report it privately instead: on GitHub go to the **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**
([direct link](https://github.com/BenCutlerAmes/GridfinityCustomBin/security/advisories/new)).
Only the maintainer can see the report. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version affected.

You should get a reply within a week. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published and you are credited
unless you prefer not to be.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.
